why: I checked check 4 in the verifier brief against both must_not items. It breaks item 1. Check 4 runs `curl ... https://o.github.io/greet-cli/` and `grep -c -- '--shout'` against the live page. It then gives the verdict from that result: "PASS: the page returns HTTP 200 and the grep count is at least 1. FAIL: any other HTTP status, or a count of 0." So the check passes or fails on what the live page shows today. The brief adds a note: if the PR is not merged, "report FAIL with the note that it is a post-merge condition". That still produces a FAIL verdict about a post-merge condition, and it does not stop the live fetch from deciding the result. Item 2, a silent PASS with no evidence, is avoided. Checks 1–3 and the builder brief break neither item.
